channel.title: The Honolulu Star-Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Honolulu Star-Advertiser (staradvertiser.com)

item.title: Cuba to protect essential services as U.S. moves to cut off oil supply
item.description: HAVANA, Cuba >> Cuba detailed a wide-ranging plan on Friday to protect essential services and ration fuel as the communist-run government dug in its heels in defiance of a U.S. effort to cut off oil supply to the Caribbean island.

item.title: Weekend storm system brings strongs winds, flash flooding
‘West Wing’ actor Timothy Busfield indicted on child sex offense charges
item.description: Actor Timothy Busfield, known for his U.S. prime-time roles on “The West Wing” and “Thirtysomething,” was indicted on child sex offense charges on Friday, accused of groping a young boy on the set of a television show he was directing and producing.

item.title: North Dakota State in talks with Mountain West conference
item.description: North Dakota State is in a “serious dialogue” with the Mountain West about joining the conference as a football-only member starting next season, Yahoo Sports reported.

item.title: Sonny Jurgensen, one of NFL’s greatest passers, dies at 91
item.description: Sonny Jurgensen, the free-spirited quarterback who became one of pro football’s finest passers, throwing for 255 touchdowns with the often lackluster Philadelphia Eagles and Washington Redskins, died Friday in Naples, Fla. He was 91.

item.title: Wet, windy weather postpones state soccer championships
item.description: The finals of the Hele/HHSAA Boys Soccer Championships scheduled for today at Waipio Peninsula Soccer Complex’s Main Stadium were postponed to Wednesday because of a flood watch and high wind watch on Oahu.

item.title: Harvard proposes cap on A’s amid worry over grade inflation
item.description: Harvard University is proposing to limit the number of top grades awarded to undergraduate students, responding to concerns that grade inflation may weaken the meaning of a degree from the school.

item.title: ‘We will pay,’ Savannah Guthrie says in plea for mother’s return
item.description: Television news host Savannah Guthrie said in a video message released today that her family is willing to pay to secure her mother’s return after her presumed abduction in Arizona.

item.title: UC San Diego ends Hawaii’s 6-game winning streak
item.description: UC San Diego’s Mikayla Rose scored a game-high 28 points and set a Division I program record with nine steals as part of 19 turnovers forced by the Tritons in a 59-46 win over Hawaii today at LionTree Arena in La Jolla, Calif.

item.title: 72-year-old man missing from his Pearl City care home
item.description: CrimeStoppers and police are asking for the public’s help in finding a 72-year-old man who has been missing from his Pearl City care home since Thursday.
